hypothesis: ensureInventoryLevels (line ~185) compares each reservation input against level.available_quantity separately and never sums inputs sharing the same inventory item and location. Two carts that each hold WIDGET on more than one line (a piece plus a two-pack) can each pass an aggregate check made before the reservation lock, and then each per-line check passes against the un-decremented level, so reserved exceeds stock and at least one run should show live reservations above stocked quantity (no_oversell failure). Expected to be reproducible, though the race window is narrow.
